_about: Key-to-icon mapping for the LOCAL icon build (generate.py --icons, docs/icons.md). Names pack-relative paths only; the pack (Guenseli, personal and private use only) and the built profile never go in the repo. Fields per key: default -> DefaultImage, on/off -> OnImage/OffImage (Dynamic Buttons, always as a pair), image -> folder/back key state Image. Positions are the docs' row,column. pass 1 = the key shows no image now; pass 2 = it shows a built-in plugin image now. Checked by check_icons.py.

ATCbutton.png.pack: Standard Avionics Suite/icons/Standard AP NAV COM XPDR/ATCbutton.png
